section_summary.extract_value: Study 1 recruited 215 female university students (M age = 19.77 years, 86% white) via an online questionnaire. Participants completed measures including the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS) and provided BMI data (N=198 for BMI correlations). Table 1 presents zero-order correlations and descriptive statistics showing a significant negative correlation between body appreciation (BAS) and BMI (r = -0.19, p < .05).
